integrity: One exact claim with a symbolic infinite-prime proof and a standalone exact finite checker. Finite checks do not certify all primes. The source dates are publication-history dates of motivating references, not a claimed publication date for this theorem.
scientific_limitations: Odd prime fields, standard unnormalized pairing, parametrized quadratic graphs, and cyclotomic-local Smith divisors only. No complex condition-number or global integral Smith assertion. Historical priority remains open to a covering general exponential-sum theorem.
title: Curvature dichotomy for cyclotomic Smith invariants of finite-parabola Fourier sampling
